title: Versions and publishing
paused: Publishing is waiting for a verified test destination and build allowance. Saved versions and backups are available.
reviewUnavailable: Private review is not configured yet.
popupBlocked: Allow a new tab for this site, then open the private review again.
confirmPublish: Publish this reviewed version? Your current draft stays saved.
confirmRollback: Restore this reviewed version on the live site? Your current draft stays saved.
busy: Checking publication. New live changes are paused until the result is known.
unknown: The hosting result could not be verified. The public site may already have changed. Publishing and rollback are blocked. A site owner must verify the hosting result before another attempt.
liveChanged: The live version changed while this confirmation was open. Cancel and review the current live version before trying again.
drifted: The hosting destination changed outside this project. Publication is paused for review.
failed: This action could not finish. Your saved files are retained. Check the version status before trying again.
limit: The saved-version limit has been reached. Remove an unused version, or ask your site owner to do this, before saving another.
conflict: The saved version changed. Review the latest version and try again.
noAccess: Your access changed. Reopen this project to check your current permissions.
backupsIntro: Restore a backup as a new, restricted project. The live site stays as it is.
restoreLimit: This workspace already has three cloud projects. Remove an unused project before restoring a backup.
restoreStorageFailed: Your browser could not save the recovery request. Allow browser storage, then try again.
restoreRemoved: That restored project was removed. Press Restore again to create a fresh copy.
reviewLaunchFailed: The review could not open. Try again, or return to your project to check your access.
downloadUnavailable: Download is not available for imported backups yet.
backupsPaused: Creating and restoring backups is currently paused. Saved backups are retained.
retainedVersionsIntro: Restore a backup or remove an unused saved version. Your current project and live site stay as they are.
confirmRemoval: Permanently remove this saved version? You will no longer be able to restore or review it. Your current project and live site will stay as they are.
confirmResumeRemoval: Continue removing this saved version? This finishes the removal already requested for this exact version.
removalPaused: Removal in progress. Resume to finish.
removalLive: This version is live. Publish another version before removing it.
removalPending: A release operation is still unresolved. This version must stay until its result is known.
removalRequired: Another saved version still needs this snapshot. Remove that dependent version first.
removalBuilding: This version is still building. Wait for the build to finish.
removalUnavailable: This version cannot be removed right now.
removalStorageFailed: Your browser could not retain this exact removal request. Allow browser storage, then reopen this version. No new removal request was sent.
removalUncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Retry or reopen this version to check and resume the same removal.
removalCheckAgain: This version changed or must be kept. Check its current status before trying again.
previousRemovalRequest: An earlier removal request is still unconfirmed. Check that exact request before removing this changed version.
confirmPrivateBuild: Build this private review? This uses one available build and does not publish your site.
privateNotConfigured: Private builds need a configured hosting destination.
privatePaused: Private builds are paused. Your saved versions are retained.
privateNoBuilds: No private builds remain in the current allowance.
privateBusy: A private build is still in progress.
privateUnknown: The private build result is unverified. Further builds are paused until it is resolved.
privateRecoveryUnavailable: This browser could not retain the exact request. No new request can start until recovery storage is available.
privatePreviousRequest: An earlier preparation request needs checking before starting another.
privateCaptureChanged: That capture did not complete before the source changed. Save a new review version when your changes are settled.
privateVersionRemoved: That saved version was removed. It will not be recreated by this request.
privateCreatorRequired: The person who saved this snapshot needs to finish preparing it.
